name: Dock surveyor
design: Tall lean female with greenish slate speckled hide, exposed flat-topped cranium and small curved mandibles, black dreadlocks tied low. Cropped charcoal canvas work jacket with rolled sleeves and one narrow leather shoulder pad, dark wrap skirt over practical trousers. Carries a compact folded three-leg range-measuring instrument vertically against right side, left hand on a round belt instrument. No weapon.
